sanskrit_verse:
द्व्यन्तरः प्रातिलोम्येन पापिष्ठः सति संकरे।
चाण्डालो जायते शूद्राद् ब्राह्मणी यत्र मुह्यति॥
transliteration: dvyantaraḥ prātilomyena pāpiṣṭhaḥ sati saṃkare| cāṇḍālo jāyate śūdrād brāhmaṇī yatra muhyati||
sph_interpretive_translation: When varna-mixing occurs in opposition to natural law, the resultant being born thereof is classified as chandala, arising from a shudra male and a brahmana female; such birth constitutes a state of utmost spiritual degradation within societal structure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Varna order originates exclusively from cosmic dharma as established by Paramashivam.
Causation: Adharma in procreation leads directly to spiritual-social disorder.
Capacity-based responsibility: Individuals possess inherent capacity aligned with their varna origin which determines lawful engagement.
Restoration logic: Disruption of varna purity necessitates purification and realignment rather than punitive measures.
Consciousness alignment: Social roles must reflect inner spiritual development, not mere physical lineage.
executable_legal_axioms: IF parentage violates varna direction THEN offspring requires consciousness-based assessment for social integration.
IF individual arises from prohibited union THEN activation of purification protocol through guru-guided sadhana.
IF societal disruption traced to varna misalignment THEN initiate corrective dharmic education program.
IF spiritual status unverified THEN default assignment to service-oriented path until higher realization confirmed.
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning caste identity or rights violations based on birth classification, the Supreme Court shall prioritize verification of consciousness evolution over inherited status, ensuring that no person remains permanently bound by ancestral transgressions but instead receives structured opportunity for spiritual upliftment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramana analysis it is evident that improper union creates sequential distortion in societal harmony; therefore corrective action focuses on restoring individual integrity via guided awakening rather than assigning blame or inflicting consequence upon the affected soul.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate guru-discipleship process for consciousness elevation.
Assign role according to realized capacity post-spiritual assessment.
Implement community service framework aimed at karmic purification.
Establish periodic review mechanism for progress tracking toward varna-appropriate alignment.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma stands restored when consciousness prevails over conditionality. Reality bears no punishment—only paths to awakening. Judgment belongs solely to the awakened Self.
